service: Apple Push Notification service (api.push.apple.com via HTTP/2) and Bark relay (api.day.app or self-hosted)

requiredSecrets.purpose: Apple Developer Team ID (JWT iss claim)
APNs auth key id (JWT kid claim)
APNs .p8 private key PEM content (ES256 signing)
App bundle id registered for push (apns-topic header)
Device token of the installed push-enabled iOS app
Bark iOS app device key (relay channel)
Optional custom Bark server base URL (default https://api.day.app)
